Sample Name.description: Unique identifier for the sample, added as a prefix to sample-specific processed data output files. Should not include spaces or weird characters.

Bioreplicate.description: Numeric biological replicate ID for the FragPipe manifest. From runsheet value if set; else one ID per Source Name within each condition when Has Tech Reps column is present; else assigned in sheet order within each condition.

Has Tech Reps.description: Indicates whether this sample is a technical replicate that should be collapsed with other samples sharing the same Source Name and Factor Value columns. Set to True for technical replicates that should be collapsed, False for distinct samples that should remain separate even if they share a Source Name. When not provided, treated as False.

Source Name.description: Biological subject identifier from ISA. Required when Has Tech Reps is TRUE. Used with Has Tech Reps to collapse technical replicate mzML rows before processing.

data_file.description: URL or path to the mass spectrometry data file in mzML format

organism.description: Species name used to extend output tables with annotations corresponding to the species.

^Factor Value\\[.*\\]$.description: Experimental group the sample belongs to. Used to create the Experiment field in the FragPipe manifest.
